# Python packages for the release job (.github/workflows/release.yml): `cryptography` for
# gpkg.py sign/verify, and its dependencies. Installed with
#   pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r .github/requirements-release.txt
# -- that job holds the developer signing key, so nothing is built from source and every file
# must match a hash below.
#
# The hashes are PyPI's published sha256 digests (https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json)
# of the wheels for CPython 3.12 / abi3 on manylinux x86_64 (the release job: ubuntu-latest,
# Python 3.12) and win_amd64 (a maintainer running the same steps on Windows). Checked with
#   pip download --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --python-version 3.12 --implementation cp
#                --platform manylinux_2_34_x86_64 ... -r .github/requirements-release.txt
# To update: bump the three versions together and take the digests from the same JSON.
